text:
mira: Heads up — planning to onboard aurora-3b-v1 into the model catalog today. Targeting 2026-04-02 16:00 PT for the canary push.

sam: I can own the deploy window. Will start the canary at :rocket: 16:00 PT.

jordan: Quick checklist before we push? smoke tests, perf, pin strategy?

mira: Minimal checklist: 1) push model artifact to bucket 2) register in catalog as aurora-3b:v1-canary 3) deploy canary to us-west-2 small pool 4) run smoke + perf scripts 5) pin if green.

lee: For smoke tests — use the new smoke harness: `tools/smoke/run_smoke.sh --model aurora-3b:v1-canary --samples 50`. It exits non-zero on failures.

sam: Noted. I'll run the harness and the latency profile. If p95 < 250ms and no failures, we consider green.

jordan: Do we have a fallback model pinned if we need to rollback?

mira: Yes — current production pin is lumen7b:v3. Rollback plan: re-pin catalog route to lumen7b:v3 and scale canary down.

sam: Deploy steps (short):
1. upload artifact: `gsutil cp aurora-3b-v1.tar.gz gs://models/aurora/`
2. register: `redwoodctl model register --name aurora-3b --version v1 --artifact gs://models/aurora/aurora-3b-v1.tar.gz --tags canary`
3. create-canary: `redwoodctl deploy create --model aurora-3b:v1 --pool small-canary --env prod`
4. run smoke: `tools/smoke/run_smoke.sh --model aurora-3b:v1-canary`
5. pin if green: `redwoodctl catalog pin --route text-gen --model aurora-3b:v1`

lee: I'll watch observability. I'll open a dashboard at 16:00 and monitor token throughput, p50/p95, error-rate. If error-rate > 0.5% or p95 regresses > 20% we abort.

jordan: What about evaluation for quality regressions? We should run the small eval set (20 prompts) after smoke.

mira: Good call. Use `evals/quick_checks/aurora_smoke.jsonl` — script: `tools/eval/run_eval.py --model aurora-3b:v1-canary --file evals/quick_checks/aurora_smoke.jsonl`

sam: If both smoke and eval pass, I'll pin and start gradual rollout (10% -> 30% -> 100% over 2 hours).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sam at 2026-04-02T23:00:00Z for aurora-3b:v1-canary on pool small-canary.

lee: Ops note — I'll set an alert for a 15-min continuous increase in error-rate and a runbook channel #eng-oncall will be notified.

jordan: Who needs to be paged if rollback happens? list?

mira: Page sam (deployer), lee (sre), jordan (ml-qa). Also notify product-safety for quality regressions.

sam: I'll keep the rollback command handy:`redwoodctl catalog pin --route text-gen --model lumen7b:v3`

mira: After pin, scale down canary: `redwoodctl deploy delete --name aurora-3b-canary`

lee: Quick permission check — sam, do you have catalog pin rights in prod?

sam: Yes I do. Verified earlier.

mira: OK. Last call: anyone object to the 16:00 PT slot?

jordan: no objections from me.

lee: fine. I'll standby.

sam: I'll post back in this thread with timestamps for each step during the rollout and the final pin/rollback result.

mira: Thanks all — tagging for visibility @product, @eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

sam: 16:00 PT — starting artifact upload now. Will update.
